verdict.rationale: Vast.ai exposes its live GPU marketplace before provisioning. Hands-on probes show keyless CLI and REST searches returning real, currently listed offers filtered by GPU type, and the docs show a `rentable=true` filter, so users can see availability rather than discovering stockouts by failure. The evidence does not document filtering or viewing availability by region, and one community report says a host's listed location was inaccurate. missing for 10: documented region/geolocation filtering of availability, evidence that location data in listings is reliable

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure

citations.quote: searched the LIVE GPU marketplace with NO account and NO API key, returning real RTX 4090 offers
returned live marketplace offers as JSON including `dph_total` (per-GPU-hour price), gpu_name, cpu specs, and reliability fields
vastai search offers 'gpu_name=RTX_4090 num_gpus=1 verified=true direct_port_count>=1 rentable=true'
